earnings.title: TD SYNNEX Reports Record Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results
highlights: Operating income of $643 million and non-GAAP operating income (1) of $736 million, an increase of 67.6% and 55.1% year-over-year, respectively.
Operating margin of 2.98% and non-GAAP operating margin (1) of 3.42%, an increase of 53 and 39 basis points year-over-year, respectively.
Returned $139 million to stockholders in the form of approximately $100 million of share repurchases and $38 million in dividends.
Announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.48 per common share, up 9% year over year.

quotes.text: We delivered another record quarter, with Distribution and Hyve both performing above our expectations and growing above market.
quotes.by: Patrick Zammit, CEO of TD SYNNEX

outlook: Revenue of $21.6 billion, an increase of 37.7% year over year, 38.4% in constant currency (1) , and above the high end of our outlook.
Non-GAAP gross billings (1) of $31.8 billion, an increase of 40.0% year over year, 40.5% in constant currency (1) , and above the high end of our outlook.
Diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) of $5.18, and non-GAAP diluted EPS (1) of $5.68, an increase of 58.7% year over year and above the high end of our outlook.

items.heading: We anticipate that our revenue and operating results will fluctuate, which could adversely affect the enterprise value of our Company and our securities.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We are subject to uncertainties and variability in demand by our customers, which could decrease revenue and adversely affect our operating results, and we have customer contracts with provisions that could cause fluctuations in our revenue.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We depend on a limited number of OEMs to supply the IT products and services that we sell and the loss of, or a material change in, our business relationship with a major OEM supplier could adversely affect our business, financial position and operating results.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: Our gross margins are low, which magnifies the impact of variations in gross margin, operating costs and our operating results.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We are subject to the risk that our inventory value may decline, and protective terms under our OEM supplier agreements may not adequately cover the decline in value, which in turn may harm our business, financial position and operating results.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We depend on OEM suppliers to maintain an adequate supply of products to fulfill customer orders on a timely basis, and any supply shortages or delays could cause us to be unable to timely fulfill orders, which in turn could harm our business, financial position and operating results.
